scope:
Archive the independently tested, pre-promotion J1311 spectrum unchanged.

This is a fixed-state regression artifact, never a cold-start solver input.

reapprovals.reason: Shared metal-line physics of the 2026-09-30 DZ audit: carbon impact profiles are now exact Voigt in frequency (compiled kernel), C I Verner photoionization covers the whole ground term. Structure arrays unchanged.

Smooth (C1) He-REOS.3 interpolation of the non-ideal part between isotherms (41a6cde), shared by DQ models; the previous linear-in-logT interpolation had ~30% jumps in nabla_ad at the isotherms. Structure arrays unchanged.

DQ shared-solver release: C I red wings bounded by the ground-state Boltzmann factor (+27% at 3500-4000 A, +14% at 4000-4500 A on its own), Rogers-Young dense He- ff table without 1/|eps|^2, and DQ's ideal-excess He-REOS.3 interpolant with analytic derivatives (together -1 to -2.5%). Structure arrays unchanged.

DQ He- free-free below John's 0.5063-micron edge now 'partial-wave' (as DZ): a first-principles e-He wavelength shape scaled to John's edge value replaces the Carbon et al. (1969) fit. Structure arrays unchanged.
